title: Wind speed at 10 m
source: NASA GMAO Modern-Era Retrospective analysis for Research and Applications, Version 2
definition: The average of wind speed at 10 meters above the surface of the earth.

status_legend.1: trend detected (FDR) and parametric test agrees
status_legend.3: naive p<0.05 only - would be a false alarm candidate
status_legend.4: not yet detectable - record too short for a trend this size
status_legend.5: inconclusive - trend this size should be detectable but is not significant
status_legend.6: excluded - some months missing (gaps or values masked by the provider)
